purpose: Provide a portable, client-neutral Codex user overlay without becoming a Codex runtime or taking ownership of private Codex state.

owns: one repository-controlled command rules file under $CODEX_HOME/rules
three field-level config defaults when the user has not already set them
plan/apply/verify/rollback evidence for its own managed assets
read-only project-local opaque machine identity status and configuration review plan
does_not_own: provider, model, base URL, routing, quota, or billing
authentication, tokens, cookies, credentials, or private keys
MCP servers, plugins, sessions, private memory including $CODEX_HOME/memories, Desktop state, or sandbox internals
project source trees, project task ledgers, project telemetry, or project sidecars
user identity, account identity, authentication state, hardware fingerprints, or device authorization
Git commits, pushes, pull requests, releases, or external project writes

allowed: Codex executable version when available
declared target paths
managed asset hashes
owned-state metadata
secret-free user environment inventory (Hermes/Codex config keys + skill lists via user_profile_export.py)
read-only project-local opaque machine identity status and profile-digest comparison via machine_identity.py
read-only Git/Python/Markdown execution preflight via execution_preflight.py
redacted Codex performance timelines without prompt, response, auth, or memory bodies
produce a redacted action plan
classify preserved user fields
fail closed on conflicts or unsafe paths
skills-only plan does not read or write native config/guidance/rules
atomic update of owned guidance block
replace owned rules file
replace the declared owned skill roots
write missing managed config fields only
explicitly requested personal-guidance replacement through the same syncer, with project-local backup and target/source digest
TOML entry parsing
managed marker/hash readback
owned skill count and hash readback
idempotent plan
remove or restore only assets still matching this overlay's recorded ownership/hash
never: restore from untrusted or unrecorded content

invoke.reason: The overlay configures Codex; it does not launch tasks, call providers, or perform project work.

evidence_requirements: apply result with managed field names only
verify status PASS and issues empty
native Windows path readback on Windows
no credentials, tokens, sessions, or config正文 in evidence
skills-only verification is not whole-overlay or runtime behavior verification
personal-guidance publication preserves native config and is verified independently of legacy managed-block ownership
non_goals: global agent personality or chat product
universal project governance without project-local contracts
production release or portable Codex installer
